testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open ribbon customization from a panel ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user right-clicks a ribbon panel title ✔ And the user chooses "Customize User Commands" ✔ Then the customization dialog opens on the "Ribbon" tab ✔ And the available commands and target custom panel lists are displayed ✔ And the target tab is "Part | 3D Model"
